zh.title: 哪些上下文共享，哪些必须隔离？
zh.lead: 切换共享实例、Router 分片和独立实例，观察信息可见性与协调路径。
zh.diagramLabel: 上下文边界与跨边界消息的示意图
zh.sharded: 同实例内 Router 分片
zh.permit: 允许转交限定的任务摘要（设计示意）
zh.leftContext: 本机草稿：登录修复的私有笔记
zh.rightContext: 团队 PR：CI 与评审记录
zh.sharedBoundary: 同一实例的共享全局上下文
zh.shardBoundary: 同一实例内两个协调上下文
zh.isolatedBoundary: 两个实例，分别代表权限边界
zh.global: ✓ 在实例允许的共享范围内，可以关联两侧工作
zh.shardState: ◇ 分片提高并行度，但上下文不会自动同步；仍需定义跨片协调
zh.isolateState: ■ 没有默认共享的底层上下文；对侧私有记录不可直接读取
zh.envelope:
限定摘要：任务 demo-login；目标修复登录；公开 CI 仍失败；请求团队协助评审。
不含私有笔记、凭据或完整历史。
zh.blocked: ■ 未获许可，只保留本侧上下文
zh.same: 共享实例内的 Worker 协作不等于跨实例 A2A；订阅广播只提供该实例内的事件分发。
zh.proposal: ◇ 摘要格式和许可开关只是教学设计；原文未给出完整跨实例协议。
zh.caption: 划分实例就是划分共享上下文与权限责任；A2A 需要显式协作，不能假设彼此能读取全部记忆。
zh.limit0: 上下文分片本身不是安全隔离；同一实例中的分片与代表不同权限边界的实例不同。
zh.limit1: 相同 Thread 的多个 Worker 接收事件不代表共享完整推理窗口，也不构成跨组织消息协议。
zh.limit2: 安全可靠的跨实例通信、协作拓扑和共享粒度仍是开放问题；本页未实现身份认证或访问控制系统。
zh.question: 把一个 Router 分成两个 Session，就获得了两个组织之间的安全隔离吗？
zh.answer: 没有。那首先改变的是协调上下文；权限边界还需要身份、存储与工具授权等机制，不能靠 Session 数量推断。
zh.step0Title: 先确定谁需要共享信息
zh.step0Explanation: 实例的部署范围决定哪些任务可以放在同一个全局上下文里。
zh.step1Title: 上下文与权限不是同一概念
zh.step1Explanation: 观察两侧的信息。共同收到事件不代表能够读取所有私有记录。
zh.step2Title: 跨边界需要明确的信息交付
zh.step2Explanation: 在独立实例或分片情境中，比较许可开关对限定摘要的影响；这里不发送真实消息。
zh.step3Title: 保留边界，定义协作责任
zh.step3Explanation: 交换一个任务摘要不等于合并全部记忆。接收方还需要判断是否接受和如何执行。

en.title: Which context is shared, and which is isolated?
en.lead: Switch between a shared instance, Router shards, and separate instances to inspect information visibility and coordination.
en.diagramLabel: Context boundaries and explicit messages across them
en.permit: Allow a scoped task summary to be handed over (design example)
en.leftContext: Local draft: private notes on the login fix
en.rightContext: Team PR: CI and review records
en.sharedBoundary: Shared global context in one instance
en.shardBoundary: Two coordination contexts in one instance
en.isolatedBoundary: Two instances representing distinct permission boundaries
en.global: ✓ Can relate both sides within the instance’s permitted shared scope
en.shardState: ◇ Shards increase parallelism, but context does not synchronize automatically; cross-shard coordination is required
en.isolateState: ■ No shared underlying context by default; private records on the other side are not directly readable
en.waiting: … No information handed across the boundary yet
en.envelope:
Scoped summary: task demo-login; fix login; public CI still fails; request team review.
Excludes private notes, credentials, and full history.
en.blocked: ■ No permission; retain information on this side
en.same: Worker collaboration inside one instance is not cross-instance A2A. Subscription fan-out distributes events within that instance.
en.proposal: ◇ This summary format and permission switch are a teaching design; the article does not specify a complete cross-instance protocol.
en.caption: Instance boundaries divide shared context and permission responsibility. A2A needs explicit collaboration, not assumed access to all memory.
en.limit0: Context sharding is not security isolation. Shards within one instance differ from instances representing separate permission boundaries.
en.limit1: Several Workers receiving a Thread event do not share full inference contexts or establish a cross-organization protocol.
en.limit2: Secure cross-instance messaging, collaboration topology, and sharing granularity remain open. This page implements neither authentication nor an access-control system.
en.question: Does splitting a Router into two sessions isolate two organizations securely?
en.answer: No. It first changes coordination context. Permission boundaries also require identity, storage, and tool authorization; session count cannot establish them.
en.step0Explanation: Instance scope determines which tasks can belong to one global context.
en.step1Explanation: Inspect information on both sides. Receiving a common event does not grant access to every private record.
en.step2Title: Crossing a boundary needs an explicit handoff
en.step2Explanation: In separate-instance or shard modes, compare the permission switch’s effect on a scoped summary. No real message is sent.
en.step3Explanation: Exchanging a task summary does not merge all memory. The receiver must still decide whether and how to act.
en.source1: Contrast: subscription fan-out within one instance
